configurations.name: devinApiKey
configurations.description: Devin service-user API key (starts with cog_). Create one under Devin Settings -> Service users with permissions to manage sessions, read playbooks, knowledge and secrets, and read organization members.

configurations.name: devinOrgId
configurations.description: The Devin organization ID the service user belongs to. All API calls are scoped to this organization.

configurations.name: devinApiHost
configurations.description: The host of the Devin API. If not specified, the default will be https://api.devin.ai.

configurations.name: sessionTrackingIntervalSeconds
configurations.description: How often, in seconds, the integration polls Devin for sessions that have a Port run waiting on them. This is also how often new session messages are posted to the run logs.

configurations.name: sessionTrackingMaxHours
configurations.description: How long a Port run may wait for its Devin session turn before it is reported as failed with a timeout.

actions.name: create_session
actions.description: Start a new Devin session with a prompt. When reportCompletion is true, the Port run stays in progress until Devin finishes the turn (or fails), Devin's messages are posted to the run logs while it works, and the run output includes the pull requests, structured output, ACU usage and start/end timestamps.

inputs.name: playbookId
inputs.title: Playbook ID
inputs.description: Optional Devin playbook to run, for example playbook-0123456789abcdef.

inputs.name: repos
inputs.title: Repositories
inputs.description: Optional repositories for Devin to work on, for example ["your-org/your-repo"].

inputs.name: knowledgeIds
inputs.title: Knowledge note IDs
inputs.description: Optional knowledge note IDs to attach to the session.

inputs.name: secretIds
inputs.title: Secret IDs
inputs.description: Optional organization secret IDs to make available to the session.

inputs.name: tags
inputs.title: Tags
inputs.description: Optional tags to add to the session. Tags starting with port: are reserved for the integration.

inputs.name: maxAcuLimit
inputs.title: Max ACU limit
inputs.description: Optional cap on the ACUs the session may consume.

inputs.name: structuredOutputSchema
inputs.title: Structured output schema
inputs.description: Optional JSON schema for Devin's structured output. When set, the structured output is returned in the run output.

inputs.name: createAsUserEmail
inputs.title: Create as user (email)
inputs.description: Optional email of a Devin organization member to create the session on behalf of. In workflows, set this from the trigger user, for example {{ .trigger.by.user.email }}. When set, the email must match an org member or the action fails.

inputs.name: reportCompletion
inputs.title: Report completion
inputs.description: When true, keeps the Port run in progress until Devin finishes the turn and streams Devin's messages to the run logs. When false, completes the Port run as soon as the session is created.

inputs.name: config
inputs.title: Additional configuration
inputs.description: Optional advanced configuration merged onto the Devin create-session request body. Only devin_mode and attachment_urls are allowed; typed inputs above take precedence.

actions.name: send_message
actions.description: Send a follow-up message to an existing Devin session. Rejected while the session is still working on a previous turn. When reportCompletion is true, the Port run stays in progress until Devin finishes this turn, and only this turn's messages are posted to the run logs.

inputs.name: sessionId
inputs.title: Session ID
inputs.description: The Devin session ID, for example devin-0123456789abcdef.

inputs.name: messageAsUserEmail
inputs.title: Send as user (email)
inputs.description: Optional email of a Devin organization member to send the message on behalf of. In workflows, set this from the trigger user, for example {{ .trigger.by.user.email }}. When set, the email must match an org member or the action fails.

inputs.name: reportCompletion
inputs.title: Report completion
inputs.description: When true, keeps the Port run in progress until Devin finishes this turn. When false, completes the Port run as soon as the message is sent.

inputs.name: config
inputs.title: Additional configuration
inputs.description: Optional advanced configuration merged onto the Devin send-message request body. Only devin_mode and attachment_urls are allowed.

actions.name: terminate_session
actions.description: Terminate a Devin session. If a Port run is waiting on the session, that run is reported as failed.

inputs.name: sessionId
inputs.title: Session ID
inputs.description: The Devin session ID, for example devin-0123456789abcdef.

inputs.name: archive
inputs.title: Archive
inputs.description: Whether to also archive the session.

inputs.name: sessionId
inputs.title: Session ID
inputs.description: The Devin session ID, for example devin-0123456789abcdef.
